# Functions permitted to be unreachable from ./cmd/..., one "file symbol" per
# line. See docs/adr/0006-code-must-be-reachable.md.
#
# The gate matches package-qualified names, not bare identifiers: Status,
# Describe and Restart each name methods on several types, and allowing one
# must not silently allow the rest.
#
# What belongs here permanently: code the static analysis genuinely cannot see —
# platform-specific implementations that do not build on the CI host, and code
# reached by reflection.
#
# Everything below is the BASELINE as of 2026-08-10, not a permanent exemption.
# It is 31 entries, mostly *Func adapter types and test-only affordances, and it
# exists so the gate can be switched on today rather than after a triage that
# would block every other change. ADR-0006 says a growing allow file means the
# rule is being evaded; this one is expected to SHRINK, and a PR that adds a
# line to it needs the reason in its message.
cmd/orbit/agent.go dirFlags.networkRef
internal/agent/client.go Client.Join
